question: A discount of 20% on one article is the same as a discount of 25% on another article. The marked price of article can be?
solution:
**Given:**

Discount on first article = 20%

Discount on second article = 25%

**Calculation:**

Let M.P of the first article = M

M.P of second article = N

⇒ M × 20% = N × 25%

⇒ M/N = 25/20

⇒ M/N = (25 × 4)/(20 × 4)

⇒ M/N = 100/80

**∴ The correct option is 3.**
